text:
elaine: Heads-up — small but consistent NDCG drop after onboarding reranker-v2 with the new sentencepiece tokenizer. Not huge but reproducible across our eval splits.

sam: Got numbers?

elaine: Quick diff from yesterday's runs:
- baseline (reranker-v1, BPE): NDCG@10 0.412, MRR 0.328
- reranker-v2 (SP, fp16 -> PTQ8): NDCG@10 0.398, MRR 0.318

raj: Hm 1.4 point NDCG relative is small but could be meaningful for some slices. Do we know if it's quantization or tokenizer?

marta: Is this on the same candidate pool ordering? If tokenization changes query tokens it can affect sparse signals we feed into the reranker.

elaine: Candidate pool ordering identical, same doc IDs. Suspect subtokenization mismatch — some queries become longer token sequences -> different context windows and maybe different KV cache behavior after quant.

sam: Can we isolate tokenizer? Quick experiment: run v1 model but swap tokenizer to sentencepiece and run eval harness. If metrics drop, it's tokenizer.

elaine: Yup doing that now. Command:
```
python eval_harness.py --model reranker-v1 --tokenizer sentencepiece --pad_mode right --seed 42 --candidates ../pools/core.json
```

eval-bot: job 4350001111-1 started on eng-eval-4 (ETA ~12m)

raj: Also record token counts distribution and avg overlap between query tokens and doc tokens pre/post tokenizer swap. If overlap drops, that would explain less signal for lexical features.

marta: Good point. Also check feature extractor that computes TF-IDF-sim / bm25als. Might be sensitive to tokenization.

elaine: Preliminary numbers from the token-swap run:
- reranker-v1 + SP: NDCG@10 0.401, MRR 0.321
So a similar drop. Looks like tokenizer is the main culprit, quantization adds a small extra gap but most is tokenization.

sam: Thanks. Next steps: 1) Align tokenization between candidate indexer and reranker (either reindex or add a token normalization shim), 2) run targeted slice eval on short queries and code-snippet queries (they're most sensitive).

raj: For alignment shim, we could precompute query-subtoken-to-original-token map and feed aggregated lexical features into the reranker as a stopgap. Low lift vs reindexing.

marta: Agree. For the long term reindexing is cleaner but costly. For canary, try the shim + run holdout 5k query slice.

elaine: I'll own the shim PR. Planning smoke runs tonight and slice eval tomorrow. If anyone wants to eyeball the tokenization diffs I pushed a small notebook to /notebooks/token-diff-4350001111.ipynb

sam: Ping when smoke done. If shim recovers >=90% of the delta we'll ship it as a hotfix and schedule reindex later.

eval-bot: job 4350001111-1 finished: reranker-v1+SP NDCG@10 0.401 (delta -0.011 vs baseline). Full logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/4350001111-1/log

elaine: Notes for release: document tokenizer mismatch in the onboarding checklist. Add step: "verify tokenizer parity with candidate indexer and embedding pipeline". Saved us from a stealth regression. :thumbsup:

raj: Great. Also add a test in the eval harness that computes tokenization overlap metric and flags >5% drop vs baseline.

marta: I'll add the test. Thanks team.
